description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

EBE Technologies develops software solutions for the transportation industry. The Entry Level Implementor/Application Developer supports the development, implementation, and maintenance of software applications, including modifying existing code, troubleshooting issues, and supporting client implementations.
Entry-level Application Developer modifying C#/ASP.NET applications, supporting client implementation, and troubleshooting SQL Server functionality

Responsibilities:
• Work with existing EBE application source code to identify, develop, and make required modifications
• Develop, modify, and maintain applications using Microsoft development technologies
• Support software implementation and configuration for client environments
• Write, modify, and troubleshoot SQL queries and database-related functionality
• Work with C#, ASP.NET, Visual Studio, and Microsoft SQL Server
• Identify, investigate, and troubleshoot application issues
• Test application changes to verify functionality, accuracy, and performance
• Collaborate with development and implementation teams to understand application requirements and resolve technical issues
• Document application modifications, testing, and implementation activities
• Follow EBE's established development standards, processes, and quality requirements
• Support ongoing improvements to EBE's SaaS and AI-enabled applications
• Learn EBE's applications, technologies, and transportation industry requirements
• Perform other related duties as assigned

Requirements:
• Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Development, or a related field
• Recent graduate or 1–2 years of relevant application development experience
• Knowledge of C# programming
• Knowledge of ASP.NET
• Experience or familiarity with Microsoft Visual Studio
• Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and database concepts
• Ability to understand, navigate, and modify existing source code
• Basic understanding of application development principles and practices
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
• Ability to learn new technologies, applications, and development environments
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team
• Good organizational and time management skills
• Ability to complete work accurately and within established timelines
